author: Gracie Johnson
title: New Court Filing Reveals Murder Suspect Claimed Karen Hollis Hung Herself - NewsBreak
text:
By Gracie Johnson ,
12 hours ago Newly filed court documents are shedding additional light on the evidence investigators presented against a man charged in the death of Karen Hollis. Randall Lendell Dejourney, who was initially charged with abuse of a corpse after Hollis' remains were found in Greene County, now faces charges of murder and abuse of a corpse. According to court filings filed May 27, a judge found probable cause for both charges following a preliminary hearing and ordered Dejourney held without bond under Alabama's Aniah's Law.
